note: SDD 流水线关卡策略 v3（2026-09-23 快车道版，用户批准）。相对 v2：①类型白名单放行「优化」；②UI 在 spec 门仍硬拒（mockup-first 人工回路），accept 门新增快车道例外——参数型优化满足全部机械条件时不拒，携机器核验证据进 Jev；③文档型命题适配（A5 不再适用于文档，新增 D1/D2）；④校准首次复盘 n≥50→20、仅 spec 门。命题极性统一：概率越高越安全。改此文件即改流程；引擎自动记录本文件 sha256 进每次决策。

calibration.note: 首次复盘：真咨询（进入 Jev 的裁决）攒满 20 条即复盘，且只调 spec 门阈值；accept 门阈值维持到数据更充分。复盘依据 docs/issues/jev-ledger.jsonl。

deny.ui_note: spec 门：UI 一律人工（mockup-first 是用户设计回路）。accept 门：UI 默认仍人工，唯一例外见 fast_lane（2026-09-23 用户批准）。
deny.sensitive_note: accept 门由引擎按实际 git diff --name-only 代码判定；spec 门按 spec 声明的实现要点关键词判定，最终以 accept 门实测为准

fast_lane.note: 验收快车道（2026-09-23 用户批准）：参数型 UI 优化免人工验收。spec 数值即合同——用户批准时给出的参数必须写入 spec「数值验收标准」小节；真机断言脚本须断言这些数值。用户否决口：spec 批准时声明保留人工验收（state.meta.hold_human_accept=true），即退出快车道。全部条件由引擎机械核验（档案 PNG/断言脚本存在性由引擎直接读主仓 docs/issues/<archive>/，不采信 agent 转述）。

propositions.instructions: The proposal in state.spec addresses every requirement stated in state.issue.body.
Every acceptance criterion in state.spec can be verified objectively by a test, a build, or captured evidence.
state.spec contains no unresolved options or parameter choices that await the user's personal selection before implementation.
The proposed changes in state.spec stay within the scope of state.issue and contain no unrelated refactoring.
The delivered change shown in state.evidence.diff matches all decisions approved in state.spec, including every numeric criterion in the spec's 数值验收标准 section if present.

The tests added or modified in state.evidence.diff genuinely exercise the behavior required by state.issue.body; for parameter-only changes (state.issue.impact is 参数), machine-verified real-app assertions against the spec's numeric criteria count as this coverage.
The file changes listed in state.evidence.changed_files stay within the implementation points declared in state.spec.
state.evidence contains before-and-after comparison data or screenshots that demonstrate the claimed improvement.
All links and file paths referenced in the delivered documentation changes are valid and resolvable.
The delivered documentation stays consistent with the current code and version facts, with no stale version numbers or statements contradicted by the repository.
